turns.text: He moved not to long before 9/11 event because I visited him that December and he died September 3rd, 2026 in Mesa with Kathy taking care of him.  I shared a lot of memories of David with you about David.

I remember his wedding to Kathy he was still living at the house on Ashland at the time and I was living in a studio apartment in Kingston Square Apartments he paid the deposit and everything to have the wedding in the community center of the complex and everyone was drinking and going to the bathroom to smoke weed.  Later I got in trouble because other people there complained about his guests.

I remember his mother died in the Ashland house a hospital bed was set up in the living room with hospice nurses visiting.  When she passing away the nurse had us stand around her connecting our hands my mom and David was still married at the time.

I remember after my first trip to Los Angeles I got in trouble I was mailed a check that I thought was real and at the time I was working as a background actor and at Universal Studios as a rides operator for T2 the ride.  I took the check to the Bank of America and after a moment she said she was having computer problems and not ti long later the police came and arrest me.  They didn't believe me and wanted to know where I got the check from and I kept telling them the truth.  After 2 or 3 days at Los Angeles County Jail.  I called David from a payphone and he let me stay there for a short time but after a few days I left and took the casino bus to harrahs al chin casino and started walking south.  I stayed a night in someone's spare trailer who gave me food and water and they drove me to casa grande, Arizona and I talked to someone about getting a place to stay and I learned that David found a place for me with Superstition Mountain Mental Health at a place called Legion House in Apache Junction not to far from where he lived.  I got on another casino bus back to that casino and I believe David picked me up from there.
It is possible they got a divorce in 95 and still lived together for a few years for the kids
